sloka: प्रहर्षोत्फुल्लनयनां पाण्डुरक्षौमवासिनीम् ।अविदूरे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा धात्रीं पप्रच्छ मन्थरा ॥२-७-७॥
transliteration: praharṣotphullanayanāṁ pāṇḍurakṣaumavāsinīm ।avidūre sthitāṁ dṛṣṭvā dhātrīṁ papraccha mantharā ॥2-7-7॥

translations.english: Seeing a royal maid clad in white silk garment and standing not very far with her eyes expanded in delight Manthara enquired:
